pages.text: A rideable cart with its own engine. Only **players and villagers** ride it.

**Inventory:** shift + right-click, or your inventory key while riding. A **fuel slot** (any furnace fuel, burning 8 times as long) and a **storage slot**. Hoppers above the track load it.

**Driving:** while stopped, press a movement key to set off. It keeps going round curves and up slopes while it has fuel.

**Stopping:** an unpowered powered rail stops it; power the rail to go again.

**Handbrake:** hold **jump** to brake to a stop, train and all.

**Towing:** hitch up to 3 carts behind it with a [[linking_bar]].

It only lights fuel while trying to move. See also the [[energy_upgrade]].
